crew.overview: In early-1970s Las Vegas, Sam "Ace" Rothstein gets tapped by his bosses to head the Tangiers Casino. At first, he's a great success in the job, but over the years, problems with his loose-cannon enforcer Nicky Santoro, his ex-hustler wife Ginger, her con-artist ex Lester Diamond and a handful of corrupt politicians put Sam in ever-increasing danger.
crew.title: Casino

crew.overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.
crew.title: Lost in Translation

details.biography: Roy Theodore Hawkins  was an American blues singer, pianist, and songwriter. Several of his songs, most notably "The Thrill Is Gone" and his first hit  "Why Do Things Happen to Me", were covered by later artists, including Ray Charles, B.B. King, James Brown,  Aretha Franklin, and Willie Nelson..
details.name: Roy Hawkins
